name: workflows
description: Developer workflow automation — create custom Claude Code agents, ship git changes end-to-end (branch, Conventional Commit, push, PR), and implement + test features via stack-aware developer and tester agents backed by React/.NET convention skills and universal coding principles.

interface.shortDescription: Create agents, ship git changes end-to-end, and implement + test features with stack-aware conventions.
interface.longDescription: Developer workflow automation skills and agents: scaffold and refine custom Claude Code agent definitions, ship working-tree changes from dirty tree to open PR (branch naming, Conventional Commits, base-branch sync, push, PR/MR), and implement and test coding tasks via stack-aware developer and tester agents that route to React/TypeScript or .NET/C# convention skills plus universal coding principles (DRY, KISS, YAGNI).
